title: Eight Sleep reviews wall
description: A night band that falls from black to navy: a big condensed 4.6 with a row of stars and a review count, a heading, a thin night-time curve with dots and a mono time label drawn across the band, a white button, and then an endless slow track of review cards: wide white story cards (a photo with the member's name over it and a large narrow-serif quote) alternating with pairs of grey social-post cards. Hovering a card lifts it with a soft shadow and nudges its photo up in scale; hovering the track pauses it.
notes: dark-scoped; cards are light (the scope's inverse)
quotes use --eightsleep-quote (a narrow serif) when the theme sets it
photos and avatars are slots; muted placeholders when empty
